eligibility: exactly two occupied modes, both among chip modes 18..21

preregistered.pair_labels: logical modes, chip mode minus window
preregistered.primary_endpoint: V_eff = 1.5 f / (1 + 0.5 f), f = -mean D_control over the two control routes
preregistered.associator_endpoint: Delta = D(LaLb) - D(Lab) on the associator block
preregistered.mutation_endpoint: Delta_control = D(LaLb) - D(Lab) on the control block
preregistered.closure_endpoint: C = Delta + 2 mean(D_control), 0 at every visibility
preregistered.hom_comparison: descriptive: |Delta - Delta_pred(V_HOM)|, V_HOM the HOM fraction read at submission
preregistered.hom_comparison_note: Delta_pred(V_HOM) omits g2, so a source exactly at the read departs from it by about 0.06 under the Perceval noise model; the comparison carries no decision

overlap_rule.statement: V_eff - 3 se_with_mesh_spread above the teleportation-fit V_eff reads overlap high; otherwise unresolved. Compiled-mesh error only lowers V_eff and the closure does not see error common to every route, so the rule is one-sided
overlap_rule.teleportation_fit: source indistinguishability 0.846 reproduces the pooled correctness 0.823 (1495 of 1816 accepted events) of teleportation job-02, job-03 and the job-02 replay on this layout under the teleportation model at g2 0.014 and the anchor read's per-mode transmission; the Perceval NoiseModel forecasts V_eff at that indistinguishability

preregistered.interpretation: photon overlap of one source pair in the compiled circuit; error common to every route lowers it and passes the closure
